findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: The damage values being printed to the console could potentially be used to inject malicious commands if the damage values are attacker-controlled and not properly validated.
findings.assumptions: Assuming that the damage values could be manipulated by an attacker or come from an untrusted source.

findings.title: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
findings.trigger: If the damage values are very large, casting them to an int could result in an integer overflow, leading to unexpected behavior or a crash.
findings.assumptions: Assuming that the damage values could be very large or come from an untrusted source.

findings.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
findings.trigger: If the duration value is manipulated to be very large, it could potentially be used to inject malicious commands if the duration values are not properly validated.
findings.assumptions: Assuming that the duration values could be manipulated by an attacker or come from an untrusted source.
